title: Laplacian Spectrum of the Weakly Zero-Divisor Graph of a Finite Commutative Ring
summary: For a commutative ring $R$ with identity, the \emph{weakly zero-divisor graph} $WΓ(R)$ has vertex set $Z(R)^{\ast}$, with distinct vertices $x$ and $y$ adjacent whenever there exist nonzero $r\in{\rm Ann}(x)$ and $s\in{\rm Ann}(y)$ with $rs=0$. The Laplacian spectrum of $WΓ(Z_n)$ has been determined by Shariq, Mathil, and Kumar, who also established that $WΓ(Z_n)$ is Laplacian integral. Building on the structural description of $WΓ(R)$ due to Nikmehr, Azadi, and Nikandish, we extend the Laplacian spectrum and integrality results from $Z_n$ to \emph{every} finite commutative ring $R$: we…
